The jewel of Hon Tre Island
A serene oasis away from the hustle and bustle of city life, Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang is a heaven for bespoke guests, amidst tropical gardens, expansive coast line and 84 villas embodying exclusivity and rejuvenation. An ideal space to reconnect and cherish every single moment with loved ones, be it a cozy family reunion or a romantic getaway.
The villas feature the elegant architecture of Vietnamese tradition and culture, with classic wooden furniture, private pools, Jacuzzi and spacious balconies overlooking the beautiful bay. Enjoy craft cocktails at the Wave Bar amidst the sea breeze or listen to the murmuring waves while enjoying a massage at the Akoya Spa hut over the ocean are spectacular experiences that must not be missed.
